data.name: Commander Bug Wars
data.detailed_description:
Intro

Step into Commander Bug Wars and take control in a wild battle between Terrans and Cyber Bugs. This is the ultimate turn-based game where your decisions matter. Get ready for epic fun and see if you can lead your side to victory!

Description

Jump into the action as you fight for supremacy in exciting campaigns and skirmishes. Customize your game and challenge up to seven other commanders.

  • Two Factions: Choose between Terrans and Bugs in your quest for domination.

  • Faction unique units: Each faction has unique units and their own set of abilities.

  • Variety of Units: Use infantry, tanks, planes, and ships to strengthen your forces.

  • Strategic Points: Capture key locations to keep your resources flowing.

  • Terrain Tactics: Use the landscape to your advantage in every battle.

  • Special Units: Deploy unique units to counter your enemies.

  • Map Editor: Create your own battlegrounds and test your strategies.

  • Are you ready to become the ultimate commander in Commander Bug Wars? The battlefield is waiting for you!

data.short_description: Dive into the thrilling clash between humans and cybernetic bugs. Lead your infantry, tanks, aircraft, and ships through intense battles. Use strategy and tactics to outsmart your foes. Every decision shapes the war's outcome. Are you ready for the challenge? Time to eat the Bugs!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Vista / 7 / 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Minimum Resolution - 1366x768, Graphics Card with at least 512MB Dedicated Memory
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Works on 32 and 64 bits systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
